column1: # OQ-310 Phase 2 — CLASSIFICATION, both strata. Frozen before Phase 3 (screen-0 calibration)
# and Phase 4/5 (incident history). HEAD 65f34a0d. Rendered WITHOUT incident history:
# no Fired: ledger, no KNOWN_STATE, no ISSUES incident text, no §7.4 instance table was read
# NOT A BLIND. The Phase 1 prior (evidence/prior.tsv, md5 8f2380b58824641d6afefc2bf3f5b3ca)
# was in view. This file measures AGAINST it; `prior` and `prior_vs_verdict` are columns.
# Criteria are the Phase 1 frozen ones. Where a hard call turned on
# "the derived artifact must regenerate identically" (an item explicitly in the frozen
# invariant list), that criterion is cited in `deciding_line` -- an APPLICATION of the
# frozen criteria, not a new criterion added at Phase 2.
# `target` is a DESCRIPTIVE column ADDED AT PHASE 2, declared as such. It is not part of the
# frozen shape criteria and no shape verdict turns on it. It records what the row asserts
# about: the SUBSTRATE (repo content), the INSTRUMENT (the checker's own discrimination),
# or both. It is recorded because 6 of 26 rows turn out to assert nothing about the
# substrate at all, which bears directly on falsifier B.
